symptom: CI #40290475168 verify failed one catalog contract test after adding a closed top-level key list: the independent fixture JSON already had sourceRefs, but the newly written expected list omitted it. The 18-case static test reported top-level catalog fields drift on unchanged valid fixture data. Test process exited 1, verify job/workflow failed, research-governance succeeded and post-checkout cleanup succeeded; no verifier execution or runner failure was demonstrated.
lesson: When closing a previously open JSON vocabulary, derive the complete existing key inventory from the canonical fixture before freezing expectations. A forgotten legitimate field causes a false-positive regression despite correctly detecting newly injected fields.
guardrail: Inventory Object.keys of the canonical JSON first, pin all existing top-level keys including sourceRefs, and retain explicit negative mutations for unauthorized additions. Treat a red static contract assertion as a fixture/expectation mismatch until full logs distinguish it from verifier behavior, build failure or runner infrastructure.
